name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Light Mode High-Contrast Overhaul: Resolved all washed-out and invisible text across Search Studio, Settings, Link Downloader, and History.
Crystal-Clear Typography: Headings, group titles, and labels rendered in deep obsidian slate (#0F172A) with descriptions in rich slate (#475569).
Interactive Controls Refinement: Re-styled Multi-Filter, category tabs, platform chips, suggestion chips, theme preset cards, and dropdown selectors for flawless readability in light mode.
Zero Dark Mode Impact: Preserved obsidian dark (#0d111a) cards, high-contrast white text, and glowing accents in AMOLED and dark themes.
